scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run check:build
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-path ../.gitignore --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json eslint.config.js vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,scss,json}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,scss,json}" "../.github/**/*.yml"
scripts.format:write: prettier --ignore-path ../.gitignore --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json eslint.config.js vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,scss,json}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,scss,json}" "../.github/**/*.yml"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:node
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:asset-loader
